title: Childhood
listenFocus: Someone describing what they were like as a child
practiceFocus: Describe three things you used to do as a child

points.title: What used to happen, not what happened once
points.rule: The preterite from days 13, 22, and 23 tells a finished event. The imperfect describes a habit, a background state, or something repeated, with no clear end. -ar verbs use -aba, -abas, -aba, -ábamos, -aban. -er and -ir verbs share -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -ían. Ser is irregular: era, eras, era, éramos, eran. Cuando era niño or cuando era niña usually starts these stories.

examples.spanish: Cuando era niño, jugaba en el parque.
examples.english: When I was a child, I used to play in the park.

grammar.notYet: Ir and ver in the imperfect (iba, veía). Keep the story to jugar, vivir, ser, and verbs you already know from days 9 and 10.

phrases.spanish: Cuando era niño, jugaba en el parque.
phrases.english: When I was a child, I used to play in the park.
We used to live in a small town.
My parents used to work a lot.

phrases.spanish: Ella era muy tímida de pequeña.
phrases.english: She was very shy as a child.
We used to study in the afternoon.

phrases.spanish: Mi hermano y yo jugábamos todos los días.
phrases.english: My brother and I used to play every day.
I used to eat a lot of ice cream.

phrases.spanish: Mi abuela cocinaba todos los domingos.
phrases.english: My grandmother used to cook every Sunday.
I didn’t have a phone back then.
phrases.note: Tenía is the imperfect of tengo. Learn it with this sentence.

phrases.spanish: Era muy feliz en esa época.
phrases.english: I was very happy in that time.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.english: What were you like as a child?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Era muy tímido. Jugaba solo casi siempre.
lines.english: I was very shy. I used to play alone almost always.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.english: Where did you use to live?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Vivíamos en un pueblo cerca de la montaña. Mi padre trabajaba allí.
lines.english: We used to live in a town near the mountains. My father worked there.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.spanish: ¿Y qué hacíais los fines de semana?
lines.english: And what did you all do on weekends?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Íbamos al río y comíamos al aire libre. Era muy tranquilo.
lines.english: We used to go to the river and eat outdoors. It was very peaceful.

practice.title: Three childhood habits
practice.instruction: Describe three things you used to do as a child, or what you were like, using the imperfect. Start with cuando era niño or cuando era niña.
tips: The imperfect describes a stretch of time, not a single moment.
That is the difference from the preterite.
